items.html: And because her first sparks were not corrected, they clung to her and took hold in her, in the secret of "a rose among thorns." And these thirty-two [sparks] that were not corrected are called "the heart of stone." And the secret of these three hundred and twenty sparks, together with the name Adonai, which totals sixty-five, all becomes Shechina, for everything is included in her.
